item.name: 07 Issue reusable Allocation at active start
13 Reusable stock is available after return

exec: pm.test("Server reports one physical deduction",function(){pm.response.to.have.status(200);var xs=pm.response.json();var x=xs.find(function(r){return r.id===Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("consumableResourceId"));});pm.expect(x.totalQuantity).to.eql(8);pm.expect(x.availableQuantity).to.eql(8);});

info.name: OrgResource O4-O5 Allocation Lifecycle and Expiry

description.content: Dynamic-ID HTTP checks for O4 allocation transitions, consent revocation, and guarded history. It creates uniquely named fictional records. Approved, returned, and consumed history is intentionally protected by A08 and remains in the isolated development database. Run only against the OrgResource local development database.
